data.one_liner: Provides a didInitState() method to access InheritedWidgets safely after initState.
data.what_it_does: Adds a mixin that calls didInitState() exactly once between initState() and didChangeDependencies(). This lets you read InheritedWidgets before the first build without using post‑frame callbacks.
use_when: You need to read InheritedWidgets during widget initialization
You want a deterministic lifecycle hook before the first build
avoid_when: You already use a state‑management solution that offers its own init hook
You prefer to avoid extra mixins for simple widgets
strengths: No code generation or build steps
weaknesses: Limited to a single lifecycle hook
Does not replace full state‑management solutions
May be redundant if you already use didChangeDependencies
